scope_note: A facsimile of the RSFSR President's office papers for his meeting of 12 December 1991 with the leaders of democratic parties and movements (archival copies published by the Yeltsin Center as Ф. 6. Оп. 1. Д. 104. Л. 128-134). Only the movement's entry on leaf 128 is imported; the entries of other parties, the Coordinating Council's appeal (its day not legible) and the other leaves are not. An official record of the President's office, not the movement's own document. The recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file.

edition_and_host.edition: Facsimile of archival copies, 13 pages (handwritten leaf numbers from 128): l. 128 the typed 'СПИСОК УЧАСТНИКОВ ВСТРЕЧИ Б.Н.ЕЛЬЦИНА С ЛИДЕРАМИ ПАРТИЙ И ДВИЖЕНИЙ ДЕМОКРАТИЧЕСКОЙ ОРИЕНТАЦИИ', dated 'I2 декабря I99I г.', prepared by 'сотр. аппарата Станкевича - Харичев И.А.' and registered '12,12,1991 № 5843'; further leaves include an appeal of the movement's Coordinating Council whose day is not legible.
edition_and_host.host: yeltsin.ru, the online archive of the Президентский центр Б. Н. Ельцина (Yeltsin Presidential Center, a nonprofit foundation): facsimile PDFs (page images, no text layer) of copies of documents of the Archive of the President of the Russian Federation, fund 91 op. 1, catalogued by the Center as 'Ф. 6. Оп. 1'. The PDFs are static files (fixed Last-Modified and ETag); the item description pages (yeltsin.ru/archive/paperwork/<id>/) are dynamic and are locators only.

visual_review.method: Every page of the 13-page facsimile was rendered from the recorded bytes and read from the image (no text layer); page 1 (leaf 128), with its heading, the movement's entry and the registration mark enlarged, carries the quotations.
